lines.text: The Teacher tells the young man to rejoice in his youth, but God will bring him to judgment.
The Teacher says to remember your Creator in your youth, before the light of the sun, moon, and stars is darkened.
Those grinding cease because they are few, and one rises at the sound of a trumpet.
Man goes to his eternal home, and mourners walk the streets.
The pitcher is shattered at the Jordan, the dust returns to the ground, and the Teacher says everything is futile.
